traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: An earthen destrier can Burrow through earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, it moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

traits.name: Lancing Charge
traits.text: If the destrier moved at least 10 feet directly before its lance arm Strike, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its damage roll.

traits.name: Tilting Strike
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The earthen destrier tramples a creature Effect The earthen destrier makes a lance arm Strike against the creature it's trampling at a –5 penalty.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ lance arm +14 (deadly d8, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+6 (2d8+6) piercing and lancing charge
